subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be exposed as a new explicit media-group action/parameter, automatic grouping of existing mediaUrls, or deferred in favor of current sequential sends?
rationale: The request adds user-visible Telegram action/tool behavior and spans multiple delivery surfaces, so the permanent API shape and fallback policy need maintainer intent before an automated fix PR is safe.

options.title: Port album support onto current mediaUrls paths
options.body: Use the existing durable mediaUrls path and add sendMediaGroup only when the media set is Telegram-groupable, with sequential fallback for non-groupable or failed album sends.

options.title: Rework the linked draft PR
options.body: Review the open draft implementation and ask for a current-main rewrite if maintainers prefer its explicit send-media-group action shape.

options.title: Keep sequential sends for now
options.body: Defer Telegram album grouping and document that multi-media Telegram sends currently deliver as separate messages.

recommendation.title: Port album support onto current mediaUrls paths
recommendation.body: Use the existing durable mediaUrls path and add sendMediaGroup only when the media set is Telegram-groupable, with sequential fallback for non-groupable or failed album sends.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and current checkout history ties him to the central Telegram send/action/reply files.
